description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlModuleService in the Rialto project, including mock setup, test scenarios for client connection, control registration, shared memory retrieval, and acknowledgment handling.

classes.name: ControlModuleServiceTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing ControlModuleService functionalities, including mock setup and various test scenarios.

methods.name: clientWillConnect
methods.description: Sets expectation for client connection to export service.

methods.name: controlServiceWillRemoveControl
methods.description: Sets expectation for control service to remove control.

methods.name: controlServiceWillRegisterClient
methods.description: Sets expectations for registering a client with the control service.

methods.name: willFailDueToInvalidController
methods.description: Sets expectation for failure when an invalid controller is used.

methods.name: playbackServiceWillGetSharedMemory
methods.description: Mocks successful retrieval of shared memory from playback service.

methods.name: playbackServiceWillFailToGetSharedMemory
methods.description: Mocks failure to retrieve shared memory from playback service.

methods.name: playbackServiceWillAck
methods.description: Mocks successful acknowledgment from control service.

methods.name: playbackServiceWillFailToAck
methods.description: Mocks failure acknowledgment from control service.

methods.name: sendRegisterClientRequestAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends a register client request and processes the response.

methods.name: sendRegisterClientRequestWithInvalidControllerAndReceiveFailure
methods.description: Sends a register client request with an invalid controller to test failure handling.

methods.name: sendGetSharedMemoryRequestAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends a get shared memory request and verifies the response.

methods.name: sendGetSharedMemoryRequestAndExpectFailure
methods.description: Sends a get shared memory request expecting failure.

methods.name: sendAckRequestAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment request and verifies the response.

methods.name: sendAckRequestAndExpectFailure
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment request expecting failure.
